nodes.label: Perceive and plan
nodes.detail: Fit every visible piece and the case from the four RGB views, then plan a grasp from CAD and the arm's kinematics.

nodes.label: Grasp and lift
nodes.detail: Close on the planned beads, lift, and confirm the hold from a fresh RGB frame and the jaw encoders.

nodes.label: Carry
nodes.detail: Move the held piece above its pyramid site, planned from the observed case pose.

nodes.label: Release
nodes.detail: Lower, open the jaw, and back away.

nodes.label: Check placement
nodes.detail: Two RGB frames one second apart must agree: piece still, hand clear, beads at their sites.

nodes.label: Hand off
nodes.detail: Pass the updated scene state to the next piece's subgraph.

nodes.detail: Re-observe and close the visual ledger for all twelve pieces.

nodes.label: Finish
nodes.detail: Open both hands, send both arms home, wait two seconds, and take a final look.
